items.quote: When any man hath a running issue out of his flesh, because of his issue he is unclean.
items.claim: The text says that a man with a running discharge from his body is ritually unclean because of that discharge.
items.object: running issue out of his flesh
items.mechanism: a bodily discharge makes a person ritually unclean
